Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.core

Class AbstractRulesEngine<O>

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.core.AbstractRulesEngine<O>
Type Parameters:
O - The output object to instantiate
All Implemented Interfaces:
RulesEngine<O>
Direct Known Subclasses:
StatefulRulesEngine, StatelessRulesEngine
public abstract class AbstractRulesEngine<O> extends Object implements RulesEngine<O>
The AbstractRulesEngine is an abstract implementation of the RulesEngine interface. The RulesEngine fires the action expression from a list of Rule objects when their conditions evaluate to true.

    • addImports

      public RulesEngine<O> addImports(Set<String> packages)
      This method adds package imports to the ParserContext in order to speed up the execution of rules and simplify the rule expression. You may want to use this if many of your rules require the same packages.
      Specified by:
      addImports in interface RulesEngine<O>
      Parameters:
      packages - A set of packages to import
      Returns:
      A reference to this RulesEngine

    • addImport

      public RulesEngine<O> addImport(String packageString)
      This adds a single package to the ParserContext in order to speed up the execution of rules and simplify the rule expression. Add the fully qualified name of the package as a string. You may want to use this if many of your rules require the same packages.
      Specified by:
      addImport in interface RulesEngine<O>
      Parameters:
      packageString - The package to import. Example: "java.util.Set"

      A reference to this RulesEngine

    • match

      protected List<Rule> match(List<Rule> ruleList, FactStore<Object> facts)

      We can use here any pattern matching algorithm: 1. Rete 2. Linear 3. Treat 4. Leaps Here we are using Linear matching algorithm for pattern matching.

      Parameters:
      ruleList - This is a list of Rule objects to filter based on when condition expression parses to true
      facts - The key/value fact store to run the rule engine against.
      Returns:
      List of Rule objects where their condition evaluated to true
